title: Artinian local algebras with finite H_1 of the residue field are filtered colimits of flat essentially finite type ones
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$ and let $(\Lambda,\mathfrak m,K)$ be an Artinian local $k$-algebra (a local ring, every descending chain of ideals stationary, with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue field $K$). Assume that $H_1(L_{K/k})$, the first homology of the naive cotangent complex of the $k$-algebra $K$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], is a finite dimensional $K$-vector space. Then $\Lambda$ is a filtered colimit of Artinian local $k$-algebras $A$ such that each map $A\to\Lambda$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], $\mathfrak m_A\Lambda=\mathfrak m$ (the maximal ideal of $A$ generates $\mathfrak m$), and $A$ is essentially of finite type over $k$ (isomorphic as a $k$-algebra to a localization $S^{-1}B$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] of a finitely generated $k$-algebra $B$ at a multiplicative subset $S\subseteq B$). (Since flat local homomorphisms of local rings are injective, $\Lambda$ is the directed union of such subrings $A\subseteq\Lambda$.)

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07FG (lemma-helper, line 2444), Section 07FF (section-inseparable); its proof (lines 2455-2549) uses Algebra Lemmas 0320 (formally smooth extensions of F_p), 07DT (essentially of finite type into Artinian local) and the Jacobi-Zariski sequence for F_p in k in K
